candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Hagrid Farm ma lùm garden pest pixel-art master spritesheet. Generate a new 1024 × 1024 PNG with genuinely transparent background. Exactly four separate full-body poses in a 2 × 2 layout of 512 × 512 cells, no labels or dividers. Each cell has its own 6 × 6 pixel square lattice anchored at its top-left: every coloured square is one flat colour; all contour steps and colour transitions on multiples of six relative to cell origin. Render as coarse genuine pixel art, NOT a high-resolution illustration with pixel filter. No antialiasing, gradients, blur, glow, shadow, fine texture or sub-block marks.
Subject: book-version Weasley garden gnome from Chamber of Secrets, ma lùm: tiny leathery creature with a very large bald irregular knobbly POTATO-shaped head, tiny narrow sharp eyes, wide grumpy mouth, short stocky body, bony little hands, small hard bare feet, simple brown rag loincloth. Mischievous greedy and funny, not scary. No hat, no hair, no beard, no pointy elf ears, no long elf nose, no garden-centre ornament, no film character. Compact about half Dobby's height. Match the chunky stepped dark contour and warm top-left lighting of the approved Dobby master visible in context, but retain this potato-headed gnome identity.
Use ONLY these 12 exact flat sRGB colours across entire sheet: #231F2E outline and eyes/mouth; #735044 shade and rag; #A57554 leathery skin; #C97952 skin light; #E7AE73 top-left head rim-light; #3F6A45 #71934B #B0BD67 weeds; #ED8A45 pumpkin; #C75B4B pumpkin shade; #FFC36B pumpkin light; #F5D69A bite flesh. Never add other shades. Outline exactly one block (6px). Head simple large irregular potato silhouette, a few broad faceted skin planes, tiny eyes, no dithering.
Composition: three-quarter toward lower-left. Within each cell centre body at local x≈256 (grid line 258); planted feet near local y=468, at least 24px empty margin on all sides. Standing-equivalent head-to-foot height 40–44 blocks (240–264px); seated poses slightly compressed, NOT filling cell. Weeds maximum 10 blocks / 60px tall at feet, never hide hands or pumpkin.
Upper-left idle: crouching among clumped weeds, both bony hands hug one small stolen orange pumpkin, tiny eyes looking slyly sideways.
Upper-right chew-1: same character, scale and baseline, biting raised pumpkin, full cheeks, eyes squeezed shut.
Lower-left chew-2: match chew-1 body and hands; head exactly one 6px block lower; open wide mouth, a clearly visible bite missing from pumpkin exposing pale flesh.
Lower-right flung: same gnome upside-down in midair, bald potato head below body, two arms and two legs splayed, dizzy expression using simple tiny crossed eyes; no pumpkin, no weeds, no motion lines, no stars. Entire inverted silhouette contained in cell.
Four poses only; isolated on alpha, no ground patch. Candidate A: prioritize exact coarse 6px lattice and clearly readable bald knobbly potato head.
